content.short: Decent is a cross-chain checkout and transaction protocol that enables seamless multi-chain interactions and asset movements for developers and users.
content.description: Decent is an interoperability protocol that simplifies the cross-chain experience by providing 'one-click' checkouts and transactions across multiple networks. By handling complex bridging and swapping logic in the background, Decent allows users to interact with dApps on any chain using assets from another. Its integration with the Mantle Network enables developers to build friction-free onboarding experiences, allowing users to join the Mantle ecosystem from any starting network effortlessly.
content.meta: Decent is a cross-chain checkout protocol for seamless multi-chain transactions on Mantle. Discover Decent on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
